title: FREE Winter Activities Centers — Crafts, Counting Activities, Holiday/New Years

overview.description: Winter/holiday themed activity bundle with centers, crafts, and counting activities. From the filename: multi-activity pack combining art (crafts), math (counting), and seasonal themes (winter, holiday, New Years). This is the seasonal-bundle format — multiple activity types packaged around one seasonal theme. Similar to the winter animal tracks pack but for a broader winter/holiday theme.

notes: Link likely expired. Seasonal activity bundle. Confirms Aless values seasonal/thematic bundling of activities — the same multi-format-per-theme pattern seen in the animal tracks pack. Seasonal themes (winter, holidays) provide natural curriculum hooks.
